title: Week 1
description: Introduction to IoT: Part I, Part II, Sensing, Actuation, Basics of Networking: Part-I

questions.question: According to the ITU Internet Report 2005 discussed in the lecture, the future Internet is expected to become wider and more complex mainly because:
options: Humans will completely stop using the Internet
Most Internet traffic may flow between devices and different kinds of things
Only desktop computers will remain connected
Internet communication will be restricted to email services

questions.question: Which of the following are characteristics of IoT systems?
options: Efficient and scalable architecture
Unambiguous naming and addressing
Presence of sleeping nodes, mobile nodes, and non-IP devices
Guaranteed continuous connectivity for every device at all times

questions.question: In the lecture, “Smart Dust” refers to:
options: A cloud storage model for IoT data
A large-scale wireless router used in smart cities
Very tiny computing devices that can be sprayed or injected for sensing purposes
A type of IPv6 address used in IoT networks

questions.question: Which statement best explains the relation between IoT and M2M communication?
options: IoT and M2M are exactly the same
M2M is broader than IoT because it includes people and applications
M2M is a part of IoT, while IoT has a broader scope of interactions
IoT does not include machine-to-machine interaction

questions.question:
State whether the following statement is True or False.

Statement: In the Web of Things, IoT sensors are replaced completely by cloud databases.
options: True
False

questions.question: In an IoT network configuration, local addresses may be valid only within a gateway’s domain. The same local address may even appear under another gateway. The main advantage of this strategy is:
options: It increases unnecessary address consumption
It helps conserve address space
It removes the requirement of a gateway
It prevents any device from communicating with the Internet

questions.question: Which of the following functions are associated with IoT gateways in the addressing strategy discussed in the lecture?
options: Providing Internet connectivity
Supporting IoT LAN intra-connectivity
Obtaining upstream address prefixes using mechanisms such as DHCPv6
Delegating addresses to nodes using SLAAC

questions.question: Which of the following is true about IPv6 compared to IPv4?
options: IPv6 uses dotted decimal notation
IPv6 has a smaller address space than IPv4
IPv6 uses hexadecimal notation and supports a much larger address space
IPv6 requires broadcast addresses in the same way as IPv4

questions.question: Which statement correctly represents the design expectation from a good sensor?
options: It should influence the measured property significantly
It should respond strongly to unrelated physical properties
It should be sensitive to the measured property and should not disturb it
It should always produce random output

questions.question: Which of the following statements about sensor resolution are correct?
options: Sensor resolution is the smallest change that the sensor can detect
For a digital sensor, resolution is related to the smallest digital output change it can process
Sensor resolution and sensor accuracy always refer to exactly the same property
Sensor accuracy does not depend only on resolution

questions.question:
State True or False.

An accelerometer that measures acceleration along the x, y, and z coordinate axes is classified as a vector sensor.
options: True
False

questions.question: A sensor gives different output for the same input value depending on whether that input was reached by increasing or decreasing the measured quantity. This error is called:
options: Quantization error
Hysteresis error
IPv6 translation error
Gateway prefix error

questions.question:
State True or False

A hydraulic actuator can produce considerable force because liquids are nearly incompressible.
options: False
True

questions.question: Which of the following statements are correct about Shape Memory Polymer actuators?
options: They may respond to stimuli such as light, heat, electrical, magnetic, pH, or moisture changes
They can show high strain recovery
They may have properties such as low density and biocompatibility
They are used only as passive temperature sensors

questions.question:
State whether the following statement is True or False.

**Statement:** According to the IoT implementation example discussed in the lecture, data gathered by a sensor travels through a gateway and a proxy server before arriving at the cloud server.
options: True
False
